headline: Atul Tantia files SEBI Reg 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure for GPT Healthcare
sum: Atul Tantia submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Regulations for GPT Healthcare Limited, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares triggering mandatory public disclosures under the takeover code.
detail: Atul Tantia, via NSE filing dated 29 Jun 2026, submitted disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4). This regulation mandates disclosure when a person acquires shares or voting rights exceeding prescribed thresholds (typically 5%). The filing establishes that the acquirer has met disclosure obligations to the stock exchange and the public, a prerequisite for any subsequent open offer or negotiated transaction in a pharma company listed on NSE.
